title.en: Add dual Clerk email-code and password access with subject-bound unverified accounts
title.zh: 增加 Clerk 邮箱验证码与密码双登录，并隔离未验证邮箱账户

purpose.en: Keep email verification code as the default SmartLingo entry while adding an explicit password path that can create a first-time account without email verification, safely recover an existing password, and manage passwords from the signed-in profile.
purpose.zh: 保留邮箱验证码作为 SmartLingo 默认入口，同时增加明确的密码路径，使首次用户无需验证邮箱即可创建账户，并可安全找回已有账户密码及在已登录资料页管理密码。

en: Default to email-code sign-in and let the learner switch to email plus password without removing either method.
Sign in a known password account or create an unknown email account immediately with the submitted password and no verification-email dependency.
Offer one-time email-code password recovery only for an existing account, and let signed-in members set or change a password without another email-code challenge.
zh: 默认使用邮箱验证码登录，并允许学习者切换为邮箱加密码，两种方式长期并存。
已有密码账户直接登录；未知邮箱则使用所提交密码立即创建账户，不依赖邮箱验证。
仅为已存在账户提供一次性邮件验证码找回密码；已登录会员无需再次邮箱验证即可设置或更改密码。

en: SmartLingo sign-in, sign-up, recovery, profile password settings, Clerk-to-D1 session bridge, administrator account creation, and permanent-administrator authorization.
Learning content, progress, colleges, payments, AI boundaries, media, Cloudflare isolation, and existing verified member records remain intact.
zh: 涉及 SmartLingo 登录、注册、找回密码、资料页密码设置、Clerk 至 D1 会话桥、管理员建号及永久管理员授权。
学习内容与进度、学院、支付、AI 边界、媒体、Cloudflare 隔离及既有已验证会员记录保持不变。

en: Persist email_verified in D1, reconcile verified identities by email, and keep unverified identities bound only to their immutable Clerk subject.
Require verified email status for bootstrap and permanent-administrator privileges across pages, APIs, college controls, payment settings, and global messages.
Use Clerk's reset-password email-code strategy, return an explicit error for an unknown recovery email, and never issue or display temporary passwords.
Enable email-code and password account access in all production Clerk applications while disabling mandatory sign-up verification and Device Trust.
zh: 在 D1 持久化 email_verified；仅已验证身份可按邮箱归并，未验证身份只绑定不可变的 Clerk subject。
页面、API、学院控制、支付设置和全局消息中的启动及永久管理员权限均要求邮箱已验证。
使用 Clerk 一次性邮件验证码重置密码；不存在的找回邮箱返回明确错误；绝不签发或展示临时密码。
所有生产 Clerk 应用均启用邮箱验证码与密码访问，同时关闭注册强制验证及 Device Trust。

en: Require zero-warning ESLint, TypeScript no-emit, verified Vinext production build, sensitive-data and Cloudflare artifact scans, all repository tests, D1 migration replay, and shared site policy and architecture contracts.

Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then exercise first-time fake-email password registration, repeat password sign-in, default email-code UI, existing-account recovery, profile password changes, and unverified-admin denial in Safari.
zh: 要求零告警 ESLint、TypeScript no-emit、已验证 Vinext 生产构建、敏感数据与 Cloudflare 产物扫描、全仓测试、D1 迁移重放及共享站点政策与架构合同全部通过。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare；随后在 Safari 真实验证首次假邮箱密码注册、再次密码登录、默认验证码界面、已有账户找回、资料页改密及未验证账户管理员拒绝。

en: A deliberately false or unreachable email can use password access but cannot self-recover; SmartLingo does not create temporary passwords or bypass ownership for recovery.
Phone verification is not part of this release.
zh: 刻意填写的虚假或不可收信邮箱可使用密码访问，但无法自行找回；SmartLingo 不创建临时密码，也不为找回流程绕过邮箱所有权。
本次发布不包含手机验证。

en: Keep SmartLingo's seven-day Clerk-linked app session and D1 member data while adding explicit verification provenance.
Preserve the isolated SmartLingo repository, bindings, Clerk keys, GitHub Actions-to-Cloudflare delivery, and the user's untracked output and temporary work files.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 现有七天 Clerk 关联应用会话和 D1 会员数据，并增加明确的邮箱验证来源。
保留 SmartLingo 独立代码库、绑定、Clerk 密钥、GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布流程，以及用户未跟踪的输出与临时工作文件。
